messages:
Avery: Opening a short Q&A thread from today's all-hands about API streaming, Console model metrics, and Optimize timelines. Post quick clarifying questions here.

Priya: TL;DR: streaming alpha = 3 weeks, console metrics beta = 5 weeks, Optimize quant advisor preview = early Q3. Will publish a calendar later today.

Jordan: For Console beta, will CS get a read-only per-customer view for troubleshooting cost spikes?

Priya: Yes — CS will have RBAC read-only access to per-customer token breakdowns and a simple cost-explain view.

Marco: Streaming note: alpha depends on a kernel patch landing on staging. Canary plan: Dedicated small pool -> broader Dedicated -> hosted. If kernel delays, alpha slides one week.

Sam: SDK update: we'll add streaming helpers and a low_latency flag in SDK 1.5. Docs + migration guide will ship with the SDK.

Casey: Optimize question: will quant advisor attach sample eval prompts and an estimated quality delta? need rollback safety.

Marco: Yes — advisor returns an expected quality delta + confidence, and the rollout UI supports one-click rollback plus traffic split.

Jordan: Any infra cost delta for low_latency mode? customers ask.

Priya: We'll show an "estimated infra delta" in Console when toggling strict-latency; opt-in does not auto-bill. Dedicated customers may need a recommended pool resize.

Nora-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://internal.redwood/all-hands/2026-03-26

Avery: Action items: Priya posts calendar, Marco posts canary runbook, Sam opens SDK PR, Jordan drafts comms. Reply here when you start your item. Closing thread after folks ack. :wave:
